system.name: StarNet
system.one_liner: Hypergraph network that links users across social platforms by fusing local trajectory graphs with a global trajectory hypergraph.

content.variant_note: an input example frame at left, a local branch (a) and a global hypergraph branch (b) stacked in the middle, and a fusion module (c) at right
content.argues: Combining a local spatio-temporal graph encoder with a global hypergraph encoder lets the model capture both trajectory-level and high-order cross-domain relations before linking users.
content.subject: Two users' check-in trajectories across two platforms feed a local module, a global hypergraph module and a fusion module that scores user pairs.

It comprises three key components: (1) Local Spatio-Temporal Enhanced Graph Neural Network Module

summary: StarNet links the same user across two social platforms from their location trajectories. The figure frames four boxes. At the left, a SocialNetwork frame shows two users' check-ins as chains of point-of-interest icons inside a teal and a peach oval, with a legend for temporal, geographical and higher-order links. Two stacked frames follow: (a) the Local Spatio-Temporal Enhanced Module, with a trajectory graph, stacked location, semantic, group and time embeddings, an attention box with compose steps and layer frames, and (b) the Global Spatio-Temporal Enhanced Module, with overlapping trajectory capsules, a hypergraph with node-to-edge and edge-to-node attention, and ContraNorm. Their outputs, a red and a blue strip, meet in (c), a KAN box that gives a column of scores and picks the matched user.

Panel count 4 includes the SocialNetwork frame (framed and titled) next to the three lettered modules; the index counts 3.
